verificationItems.actual: Live over candidate k8s33 (sha256 5cd98af…): (1) admin creates throwaway private_key SSH credential → HTTP 200. (2) GET /business/deploy/credentials (admin) returns DTO without any secret-bearing key (findSecretKeys hits=0: no secret/secretEncrypted/privateKey/pem/token field), matching DeployCredentialResponse {id,name,username,authMode,version,status,timestamps}. (3) DB stores secret_encrypted as 'v1:<base64>' ciphertext ≠ plaintext (verified via mysql companion step, recorded as v5-db-ciphertext). (4) Ownership: non-creator with valid deploy grant (u1, task:view, not the creator) cannot list/read the creator credential (404/403 — credential routes beyond create/list are not registered). TWO findings recorded: (a) NO GET /business/deploy/credentials/:id detail route exists → checklist '单条详情' probe returns HTTP 404 itself; (b) NO business:deploy:credential:* permission key is seeded (deploy_seed.go has only package/template/task) so 'credential:view' grant is rejected as role.permission.invalid — credentials are admin-only today with NO grantable non-admin authorization; residual SEC-004 gap: ListCredentials has no creator/owner filter, so if credential:view were ever bound all holders see all metadata (latent, no current exposure).
verificationItems.fixRef: latent only: deploy_credential.go ListCredentials no ownership filter; no credential:* permission seed (see actual)
verificationItems.t03Recheck: 2026-11-23 T03 实现: (a) 已补 business:deploy:credential:list|create|update|delete 权限点, 写入 deploy_seed.go F 菜单 (Sort 12-15) + 后端 zh/en i18n (前端 fallback 与模块 locale 已同步, menu-contract 250 权限 PASS), 并绑定 GET/POST /credentials 与 PUT/DELETE /credentials/:id; (b) 详情 GET /credentials/:id 仍不存在; (c) SEC-004 残差仍在: DeployCredential 表无 owner/scope 字段, CRUD 均无 creator/范围过滤 → 持有 credential 键的非管理员可读/轮换其他范围凭据引用(密文不外泄)。本地候选 0586a9e2 实测: credential:list 可 200 读取且响应 0 个 secret 键, POST/PUT/DELETE 全部 403; 远端实例尚未用该候选重跑。
